payload.body: For hv (your todo 90), cc on meaning. I recommend the register says what doctor does: read_or_mutate "mutate", recoverability "one-way", with the side effect named (a missing store is made from the canon and an older one is migrated, one way, as every verb's open does), and the door that writes nothing stays --read-only, which 0717 built and dc's guard asks; its MCP exposure then needs a recoverability_anomaly in ic's shape, since a repeat changes nothing. Never-write by default would break every place doctor is the first verb to open a store: CI's pull-request check runs intent doctor on a fresh checkout with no store (pr-checks.yml:216-218), so it would exit 2 and fail every pull request, or, judged without the store, it would drop the store-backed checks (the render record's view skew, the backup, the search index) there and on the first run after an upgrade, which then needs a second behaviour change to say so.
